name: heide-skills
description: Skills for students and note-takers: handwritten notes into Obsidian, lecture material into Anki cards, and exact study-plan solving.

plugins.name: paper-to-obsidian
plugins.description: Photos or scans of handwritten pages into transcribed, linked Obsidian notes, with open items extracted and a scan-quality archive PDF.

plugins.name: anki-lecture-cards
plugins.description: Lecture slides, readings, exercises and old exams into exam-oriented Anki decks built from YAML card files, with an optional formula sheet.

plugins.name: curriculum-solver
plugins.description: Degree and course planning by exact enumeration of every valid study plan, with the price of each rule.
